content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Labels and Non-Local Returns** as part of **Decision-Making and Loops**. Apply labels and non-local returns by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—Labeled Loops, Returns from Lambdas, Local and Non-Local Control Flow—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.

items.text: Local and Non-Local Control Flow depends on task lifetime and execution context. Keep child tasks inside an owning scope, handle cancellation cooperatively, and avoid unsynchronized shared mutable state.
